name: Rio Woodworks & Design
old_description: Rio Woodworks and Design is Albuquerque's best custom design and specialty wood work studio.
about:
Rio Woodworks & Design operates a custom design and specialty woodwork studio in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The company focuses on bespoke wood fabrication for both functional and architectural applications, offering a showroom where clients can view collections and tour the production shop.

The studio produces custom cabinets, furniture, doors, gates, and architectural elements, working with a range of premium wood species from pine to birds-eye maple and other hardwoods available upon request. Finishing services include stain and painted options applied in-house, with a broad spectrum of wood tones and colors.

The business serves commercial clients as well as residential customers seeking tailored woodwork. Projects span custom cabinetry for commercial spaces, bespoke furniture, and architectural wood components, with the company highlighting its commercial category alongside residential offerings.

Rio Woodworks & Design emphasizes access to top-grade lumber and a broad palette of wood tones and colors, positioning its material selection and finish flexibility as core differentiators. The studio invites prospective clients to visit the shop to see its capabilities firsthand.
